05 About MCR Concept

Practical experience, from bar to factory floor

Sri Lankan ingredients. Global opportunities.

MCR Concept is a food and beverage development company based in Battaramulla, Sri Lanka. Our background covers beverage consulting, product development and production for hotels, distilleries and food manufacturers.

We do not stop at a recipe. We design the process, build the equipment and train the people who will run it.

06 Common Questions

FAQ

Who owns the formula?

You do. Full ownership passes to you when the project is complete and paid for.

Do you sign an NDA?

Yes. We sign a mutual NDA before you share any confidential details.

Do you manufacture products?

We develop products and build processing and packaging equipment. Production takes place at your factory or a co-packer of your choice.

How long does a project take?

Most formulation projects take 4 to 12 weeks, depending on the product and testing required.

How is a project priced?

We send a fixed quotation after reviewing your brief. There is no charge for the first discussion.
